0022600186.text: The Heat (2-5) are 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and they come in on a one-game losing streak with a 1-3 home record and a 1-2 road mark. The Clippers (1-6) are 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, and are on a six-game losing streak after a 0-4 road start. Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist sprain, 28.4 points per game this season) and Myron Gardner (quadriceps bruise) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Los Angeles is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat won both games of the 2025-26 season series, most recently a 140-123 win in Miami on December 1, 2025.
